headline: UK energy bills to rise 26% as gas prices surge amid Iran conflict
summary: Britain's energy bills are set to increase by 26% from January, with Ofgem confirming the energy price cap will rise to £2,166 annually.
why: Higher household energy costs impact consumer spending and inflation, influencing UK economic conditions and policy decisions.

impacts.name: UK energy price cap
impacts.why: Rising gas prices increase household energy costs.
